messages:
Zoe: Quick poll  who wants to run a tiny March board sweep next week? 8-person max, $5 buy-in. Winner gets bragging rights + a mysterious mystery prize. :trophy: :mystery:
Marcus: Im in. Also can someone bring a whiteboard so we dont have to scribble on napkins? :white_large_square:
Eli: Count me in if theres pizza. Trade offer: Ill draft late in exchange for a slice guarantee. :pizza:
Tasha: Ill bring the whiteboard AND some dry-erase markers. Also voting emoji please: :thumbsup: to join, :eyes: to spectate, :moneybag: to join + buy-in.
Priya: Love the idea. Can we do single-elim with a consolation bracket so people still get snacks? :bagel: :taco:
snack-bot: Poll created: "Board Sweep Participation" (thumbsup: Join, eyes: Spectate, moneybag: Join+Buy-in)
Zoe: Also planning to do a quick pre-game 5-minute rules refresher so we dont have last-minute disputes about tie-breakers.
Marcus: Tiny rule: no benching roster during matches (kidding). But seriously, lets set a 2-min time limit for moves during live board.
Eli: Meme corner: whos bringing the cursed foam finger? Ill bring it on the condition we hide it from management. :joy:
Tasha: Reminder that the all-hands runs 3pm so schedule matches around that. Ill make an hour-by-hour bracket sheet.
Priya: Also shoutout to Zoe for organizing the last snack runthat charcuterie was peak. :clap: :heart:
Marcus: Agreed, top-tier snacks. Zoe: youre officially in the hall of fame. GIF incoming.
Zoe: Thanks! Happy to be snack champion. Also, if we hit 9+ signups we do two pods and a final — can someone volunteer to be referee?
Eli: Ill referee one pod. Promise to be impartial unless there are bagels on the line.
Tasha: Ill stream the final for remote folks. Can we angle the laptop so its not filming my messy desk? :sweat_smile:
snack-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Board Sweep & Snacks" Thu 18:00 (tentative).
Zoe: Final: sign up by Wed noon. Link: https://tinyurl.com/board-sweep-signup. React to this thread when youre in and Ill ping for the $5 Venmo.
Marcus: In (thumbsup). Also requesting a tiny engraving on the prize:  "Office MVP" with permanent marker.
Eli: In + pizza demand noted.
Priya: Spectating but bringing snacks. The charcuterie lives rent-free in my heart. :cheese:
